newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle trade near steady - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle trade near steady - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were near steady on a live basis, compared with Wednesday's close, USDA said. Trade was slow to moderate.
